name: Maps, books, signs and displays
note: Removed with the first generation's server (tag pre-refactor) in the restructuring of 2026-11; returns with VIEW1. First generation: Empty maps become filled maps of new maps, and the players carrying them get their data and markers (on the map, on its edge, or none far off), as both official servers send them; maps held in a hand explore the terrain around their holder, every block state's color, shading and water depth drawn as both official servers draw them. A book and quill in a hotbar slot or the off hand takes the pages a client edits (100 of 1024 code units at most, kept as sent) and is signed into a written book (a title of 32 at most, the player as author, generation 0, pages as plain text, resolved), and a written book opens for reading and is copied with books and quills, and filled maps with empty maps, and filled maps are extended with paper into new maps of the next scale at crafting tables and in crafters, as both official servers do; its deviations: maps in the Nether do not explore (the official servers draw a pattern not described publicly); banners and item frames are not modeled; signs and displays are not shown; books given unresolved are not resolved when opened
